title: Severe Hyperglycemia Protocol
steps: Check for symptoms: dry mouth, fatigue, nausea, blurry vision, etc.
If CGM trend is ↑ or ↗ and no correction taken, assume active spike.
Take full correction dose based on CF if no insulin is on board.
Avoid any carbohydrate intake until BG <10.
If BG >17.0 mmol/L, hydrate more (up to 750ml) and take correction +10–20% if safe.
Avoid physical activity unless insulin is active.
Recheck BG in 60–90 min. If not dropping by >2.0 mmol/L, re-correct and continue fluids.
Seek medical help if BG >17.0 for 3+ hrs, if ketones are present, or if nausea/vomiting occurs.
